# Taper fixture: naca2412_taper_r60_t30_s60.stl

## Description
A tapered NACA 2412 wing: chord changes linearly with Z, from 60 mm at the root (Z=0) to 30 mm at the tip (Z=60 mm), with the leading edge held at a fixed local X so the taper is expressed as the trailing edge moving inward -- a straight-leading-edge tapered wing, not a straight-quarter-chord one. Built from exactly 2 stations (root, tip): because chord(z) is affine in Z, linear interpolation between the two scaled outlines is geometrically exact at every intermediate Z, so 2 stations is not an approximation here.

## Origin convention
The unit NACA section (chord along X, thickness/camber along Y) is generated once and scaled per station; every station is then shifted by the same constant offset so the *root* station's own X/Y bounding box is centred on X=0, Y=0 -- matching the constant-section airfoil fixture's convention. The tip station is positioned relative to that same fixed frame, so its bounding box is not separately centred. Z is spanwise, root at Z=0, tip at Z=60 mm.

## Exact dimensions
- NACA designation: 2412 (m=0.02, p=0.4, t=0.12)
- Root chord: 60 mm
- Tip chord: 30 mm
- Span: 60 mm
- Taper: linear, leading edge at fixed local X (straight LE)
- SHA-256 (STL): fb7d14531a990fe2873fc2da5c2d07aa3f1c25d258d3bed0069181294e958a90
- Points per surface: 120 (cosine-spaced; outline vertex count 238)
- Stations: 2 (root, tip) -- geometrically exact for a linear taper, see above
- Triangles: 948 (476 side wall + 472 cap)
- Format: binary STL, deterministic fixed ASCII header, no timestamps

## Local thickness by spanwise station
Local max thickness is the maximum upper-minus-lower surface separation (at matching cosine-spaced chordwise positions), in millimetres -- the number that decides whether a structural web fits at that station, not the bounding-box Y extent (which also carries camber offset).

| Z (mm) | Chord (mm) | Local max thickness (mm) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 60.0000 | 7.1986 |
| 15 | 52.5000 | 6.2988 |
| 30 | 45.0000 | 5.3989 |
| 45 | 37.5000 | 4.4991 |
| 60 | 30.0000 | 3.5993 |

## Purpose
M5 fixture: chord changes with Z. Exercises intersection-point and margin behaviour that assumes a constant section (M2-M4) breaks for -- both the chord axis and the local thickness at every station change, not just the outer boundary.

Generated by `python tools/make_fixtures.py taper --naca 2412 --root-chord 60 --tip-chord 30 --span 60 --points 120`.
